entities.summary: Omar Ismael Montes Moreno is a Spanish singer and media personality who became known for his appearances in reality shows such as Mujeres y Hombres y Viceversa, Gran Hermano VIP, and Supervivientes, as well as for his relationship with Isa Pantoja. As a singer, he has achieved great success with some of his songs, such as "Alocao", "Solo" or "La Rubia ", with which he has achieved several platinum and gold record certifications.
